baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain jaza'an min rabbika ata'an hisaban joins recompense, sovereign source, transfer, and calculation in one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: An action is met by a corresponding return, the Lord owns and issues that return, ata marks its handover, and hisab makes its amount deliberately reckoned rather than accidental.

activation_trace.role: Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocal relation at the start of the chain.
Lordship as ownership and sovereignty identifies the authority that controls the return.
Handover and giving turn the corresponding return into an actually transferred grant.
Counting and estimation make the grant a consciously determined quantity.

changed_reading.before: A reward from your Lord, a calculated gift.
changed_reading.after: A sovereignly issued return that answers action and is handed over in a deliberately reckoned amount.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Jaza'an can carry standing in another's place, Rabb can carry staged nurture and completion, and hisaban can characterize ata'an as sufficient.
baseline_models.mechanism: The return is not only counted: it stands in satisfaction of what preceded, emerges from continuing Lordly care, and arrives as a handed-over provision whose operative measure is that it is enough.

activation_trace.role: Standing in place of another and sufficing reframes recompense as a satisfying provision.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the donor relation developmental rather than momentary.
Giving and handover provide the concrete transfer by which care reaches its recipient.
Sufficiency and enrichment make hisaban a measure of enoughness, not merely arithmetic.

changed_reading.before: A quantified prize paid after the fact.
changed_reading.after: A Lord-cultivated grant that satisfies the occasion and suffices the recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punitive sequence defines recompense by exact equivalence and an exhaustive fixed record; the favorable culmination retains reckoning but apposes recompense to a Lord-sourced gift whose hisab branch also means sufficiency. The two outcomes are equally non-arbitrary without being framed by the same distributive relation.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal recompense anchors the shared judicial category that context differentiates.
Giving marks the favorable return as a donor-side transfer rather than bare equivalence.
Sufficiency lets the final measure remain exact while emphasizing adequacy or amplitude.
A quantity equal to need or counterpart gives the punitive recompense an explicit equivalence rule.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration establishes that no item escapes the accounting system.
A written fixing that obligates judgment makes the prior enumeration dispositive rather than informational.

structural_cues: The punitive sequence pairs recompense with exact accord at 78:26 and closes with exhaustive written enumeration at 78:29; the favorable sequence culminates by naming recompense as a gift at 78:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact equivalence, exhaustive fixation, and the focus pairing of gift with sufficiency; I infer a deliberate asymmetry in how just outcomes are distributed. A live alternative is that hisaban remains only a fixed numerical qualifier and carries no surplus beyond equivalence.

changed_reading.before: The favorable reward is a one-for-one amount computed like every other recompense.
changed_reading.after: The favorable award is fully accountable yet presented as a sufficient Lordly gift, whereas punitive recompense is the outcome explicitly bounded by equivalence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated making and preparation establish an environment, descending provision produces growth, and the favorable catalogue ends with a cup filled to its top. These stages activate Rabb as nurture and completion, ata as attentive provision, and hisab as sufficiency: the focus award completes an already operating economy of care.

activation_trace.role: A provision that stands in place and suffices makes recompense the completion of prior preparation.
Nurturing something stage by stage supplies the governing process behind the provision sequence.
Service and furnishing what another needs make the gift the delivery phase of care.
Enoughness characterizes the completed provision as ample for its recipients.
Rendering something into a useful state begins the surah's staged provisioning pattern.
Preparing and leveling an affair makes the created setting function as advance accommodation.
Provision prepared for one who arrives turns descent into hospitality within the wider mechanism.
Vegetation emerging from the earth supplies the visible yield of the prepared provision.
A cup filled to its top gives immediate material form to sufficiency just before the focus ayah.

structural_cues: Ayat 78:6-16 move from prepared habitat through descending water to growth and gardens, while 78:31-34 restage protection, gardens, fruit, companionship, and a full cup immediately before the award.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a staged creation-and-yield sequence and a full favorable provision; I infer that this repeated provider pattern specifies min rabbika in the focus. The live alternative is that the earlier cosmology only demonstrates power and does not define the later gift's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A discrete prize delivered only at the end.
changed_reading.after: The culminating handover of a long-prepared, growth-producing, and fully sufficient Lordly provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Everything is exhaustively enumerated and fixed in a record; at the surah's close, each person looks at what their own hands advanced. That sequence gives jaza-hisab an auditable provenance chain from prior agency through preserved record to returned outcome.

activation_trace.role: Recompense answers an act and therefore supplies the return end of the provenance chain.
Practical oversight and examination turn the calculation into an inspectable accounting operation.
Exhaustive enumeration preserves every input needed for the eventual return.
Fixing a record that entails judgment secures the enumerated inputs against loss or revision.
Directed sight or insight makes the result personally inspectable rather than hidden.
Advancing something forward supplies temporal direction from prior deed toward later outcome.
What the hands earn assigns the recorded input to the person's own agency.

structural_cues: The exhaustive record at 78:29 precedes both outcomes, and 78:40 closes the surah by making prior handiwork visible to its agent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enumeration, binding record, personal inspection, prior advancement, and hand-earned agency; I supply the arrow deed to record to recompense. A live alternative is that 78:40 illustrates only the adverse side and should not be projected onto the favorable grant.

changed_reading.before: An abstract reward whose calculation remains offstage.
changed_reading.after: An auditable return whose inputs are the recipient's preserved acts, even though its favorable delivery is called a gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, creatures do not control address and may speak only by merciful permission and with correctness. This authority structure revises the debt-settlement potential of jaza: ata min rabbika is a merciful sovereign conveyance, not a receivable that recipients can demand through bargaining speech.

activation_trace.role: Debt collection and settlement keep a claim-like construal of recompense available for context to revise.
Ownership and sovereignty locate control of the grant wholly with its Lordly source.
A handover from the sovereign source is the positive transfer whose legal posture is being tested.
Mercy and tenderness qualify the authority behind both access and grant.
Possession and power of disposal are explicitly denied to creatures in the domain of address.
Reciprocal address identifies the channel over which creatures lack independent control.
Permission and authorization make even acceptable speech dependent on sovereign leave.
Correctness settled opposite error constrains what authorized speech may accomplish.

structural_cues: Ayah 78:36 is immediately followed by the expansion of Rabb into cosmic lordship and mercy, denial of controlled address, and permission-bound correct speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies merciful sovereignty and a strict access protocol; I infer that the same asymmetry governs the adjacent award, shifting it from collectible debt to authorized gift. The live alternative is that the restrictions regulate courtroom speech only and say nothing about the award's claim status.

changed_reading.before: A settled receivable that the rewarded party could regard as independently claimable.
changed_reading.after: A just return that remains an uncommandable conveyance of merciful sovereignty, received as gift rather than negotiated as debt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant j-z-z mapping for jaza and carries an agricultural image across domains. It remains anchored by the supplied focus mapping and by the explicit water-to-grain-to-vegetation-to-garden sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory harvest image that colors, but does not replace, the ordinary recompense sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus occurrence jaza'an is supplied with a j-z-z branch for ripeness at cutting time, while Rabb, ata, and hisab can furnish cultivation, handover, and measured allotment.

activation_trace.role: Ripeness at the time of cutting recasts the recompense moment as harvest readiness.
Staged nurture supplies the cultivation process that brings the yield to completion.
Handover turns the ripened yield into a received allotment.
Measurement bounds the harvest image as an apportioned yield rather than an unstructured abundance.
Seed that grows and bears grain supplies the productive unit of the harvest image.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the growth stage before ripeness.
A garden enclosed by trees supplies the mature cultivated setting into which the focus award arrives.

changed_reading.before: Recompense as an abstract judicial payment.
changed_reading.after: Recompense imaged as a nurtured yield that has reached its cutting time and is handed over in a measured, sufficient allotment.

strongest_changes: The whole-surah contrast separates punitive recompense explicitly governed by equivalence from favorable recompense explicitly named as a sufficient Lordly gift.
The creation, water, growth, garden, and full-cup sequences turn the focus award into the completion of staged provision rather than an isolated final prize.
Exhaustive recording and the closing inspection of what hands advanced make the reward an auditable return on preserved agency.
The post-focus limits on ownership of address and permissioned speech recast the award as mercifully authorized and uncommandable rather than negotiable.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package places the focus after mirrored punishment and garden sequences and before a sovereignty-and-speech scene. That span activates both a disciplined justice/gift asymmetry and the packet's form-distant harvest branch without forcing either into a single final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Hisaban may primarily signal numerical calculation, sufficiency or amplitude, or a deliberate overlap of those branches.
The move from permission-controlled speech to the non-claimability of the adjacent gift is structurally plausible but remains reader-supplied.
The harvest reading depends on the non-dominant j-z-z mapping and must remain exploratory rather than lexical substitution.
